Method of Attack: Phishing campaign impersonating WhatsApp voice message feature
Redirect to website prompting to click 'Allow' to confirm not a robot
Subscription to browser notifications sending in-browser advertisements for scams, adult sites, and malware
Impacted Systems: Browsers and applications storing account credentials
Attack Vector: Phishing email with embedded 'Play' button and audio clip details
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing email sender masquerading as 'Whatsapp Notifier' using email address of Center for Road Safety of the Moscow Region
Landing URL requesting victims to click 'Allow' outside WhatsApp domain space
Absence of WhatsApp logo in phishing email
